summary: Initial independent core, Anthropic, compatible and OpenAI packages from the verified M2/M3 extraction.

packages.notes: Provider contracts, transport, utilities and orchestration in four modules; explicit registries and no built-in provider dependency.
packages.compatibility: New release unit at 1.0.0. Moved types retain one definition; binary compatibility with the monolithic module is not promised.

packages.notes: Standalone Anthropic Messages, tools, batches, upload and skills with typed settings.
packages.compatibility: New release unit at 1.0.0; legacy settings overloads remain in the canonical compatibility facade.

packages.notes: Generic compatible chat, completion, embedding and image wire behavior without concrete provider dispatch.
packages.compatibility: New release unit at 1.0.0; the native generic factory is distinct from the legacy dispatch class.

packages.notes: Standalone OpenAI Responses, chat, media, Live, batches, files and skills, sharing compatible wire implementations.
packages.compatibility: New release unit at 1.0.0; native OpenAIProvider is explicit, while the old facade retains its previous concrete return type.
